The search placeholder is ‘Título, autor, resumen o etiqueta’. Keep the complete labels legible and controls at normal application size. No huge title or enclosing filter panel. A thin rule ends the band and the content begins immediately below it.

Show the topic heading ‘Automation Anywhere’ and two quiet ruled entries: ‘Bot no inicia: error user.not.logged.in’, author ‘Jeiser Vargas’, date ‘2026-10-13’; and ‘Integración de SharePoint con Automation Anywhere Control Room’, author ‘Renato’, date ‘2026-10-13’. Keep these content rows visually subordinate. The crop excludes the unchanged portal sidebar and browser chrome. This is a real working application layout, not a poster. Do not add slogans, illustrations, extra controls, or option labels inside the image.
